newsitem.title: USA: Combined Cos Intl trading halted by SEC.
newsitem.headline: Combined Cos Intl trading halted by SEC.

text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission said Monday it had suspended trading in the shares of Combined Cos International Corp through June 2.

The SEC said it ordered the trading suspension in the Las Vegas-based maker and distributer of video game systems "because of questions raised as to the adequacy and accuracy of publicly-disseminated information."
The SEC questioned the accuracy of reports by the company in its financial statements, which were included in a registration statement and periodic reports filed with the agency.
Further, the SEC cited a lack of audited financial statements included in Combined Cos's registration statement.
"The commission determined that the public interest and the protection of investors requires a suspension of trading in CCIC securities," the agency said.
Officials at Combined Cos could not be reached for comment.
The SEC said on March 12 that it had filed a civil complaint alleging that the company's independent auditor had issued "materially false and inaccurate audit reports."
